name: basicJSONHandler
title: Collect JSON events into a list

origin.description: A handler that builds the value from parser events.

arguments.name: simplify
arguments.text: When TRUE, equal-length atomic rows become a matrix.

origin.details: Pass the handler to fromJSON. Whole numbers arrive as integers. An object becomes a named list. simplify = TRUE turns rows of the same length into a matrix, by row.
origin.value: The value collected by the handler.
origin.example: The handler value of [1, {"a": true}], then the integer matrix from [[1, 2], [3, 4]] when simplify is TRUE.
